ops.entry: WHEN reviewing a class-wide contract or fix DO trace every output to its source across phases and inventory boundary-scoped state, aggregates, and prefilters. Probe excluded exception families and one reachable case beyond the boundary; report counterexamples together rather than stopping at the first.
ops.why: Plan reviews found successive missed output producers; validation found separately scoped audit mechanisms. Both reward an up-front census, not another instance replay.

originals.original: WHEN re-reviewing a fix meant to close a defect class DO map the contract's distinct states across phase changes, probe the exception families the guard excludes, and test one reachable case beyond the boundary. A passing replay of the original failure closes that instance, not the class.
